newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: CA says would fuse Hungary operations with MHB.
newsitem.headline: CA says would fuse Hungary operations with MHB.

text.p: Creditanstalt-Bankverein wants to fuse its operations in Hungary if it succeeds in buying state-owned Magyar Hitel Bank, Creditanstalt chief executive Guido Schmidt-Chiari said on Friday.
Hungary's privatisation agency has offered a controlling stake in Magyar Hitel Bank to strategic investors. Creditanstalt is already active on the Hungarian market through its unit Creditanstalt Rt.

Schmidt-Chiari, speaking during an investors' fair, said Creditanstalt wanted to take on the entire 94 percent stake that Hungary is offering in Magyar Hitel Bank. He ruled out a joint bid with another Austrian bank. -- Vienna Newsroom, 43-1-53112-258
